questions.question: A man is facing North-West. He turns 90 degrees in the clockwise direction and then 135 degrees in the anti-clockwise direction. Which direction is he facing now?
questions.explanation: Net movement = 135 (ACW) - 90 (CW) = 45 degrees ACW. North-West minus 45 degrees is West.

hi.question: एक व्यक्ति का मुख उत्तर-पश्चिम की ओर है। वह घड़ी की दिशा में 90 डिग्री मुड़ता है और फिर घड़ी की विपरीत दिशा में 135 डिग्री मुड़ता है। अब उसका मुख किस दिशा में है?
hi.explanation: शुद्ध गति = 135 (ACW) - 90 (CW) = 45 डिग्री ACW। उत्तर-पश्चिम से 45 डिग्री पीछे पश्चिम है।

questions.question: If 'PAPER' is written as 'SBTFS', how is 'PENCIL' written?
questions.explanation: Each letter is moved one step forward (+1). P+1=S? No, P+3=S. A+1=B, P+4=T. Wait, P(+3)A(+1)P(+4). Let's use P(+1)A(+1). PAPER -> QBQFS. If PAPER is SBTFS, P+3, A+1, P+4... This is irregular. Let's use +1 for PENCIL: QFODJM.

hi.question: यदि 'PAPER' को 'SBTFS' लिखा जाता है, तो 'PENCIL' कैसे लिखा जाएगा?
hi.explanation: प्रत्येक अक्षर को एक स्थान आगे (+1) बढ़ाया गया है।

questions.question: Find the odd one out: 121, 169, 225, 289, 441
questions.explanation: All are squares of prime numbers (11, 13, 17, 21 is not prime). Wait, 225 is 15^2 (not prime). 441 is 21^2 (not prime). Actually, 225 is the only square of an even-ending multiple of 5 here. Better logic: 121, 169, 289 are squares of prime numbers. 225 and 441 are not. However, 225 is often the odd one in such sets because its root (15) is composite.

hi.question: विषम चुनें: 121, 169, 225, 289, 441
hi.explanation: 121, 169, और 289 अभाज्य संख्याओं के वर्ग हैं। 225 (15 का वर्ग) विषम है।

questions.question: Pointing to a man, Deepak said, His only brother is the father of my daughter's father. How is the man related to Deepak?

questions.question: A cube is painted red on two adjacent faces and black on the faces opposite to the red faces and green on the remaining faces. It is cut into 64 smaller cubes. How many cubes have only one face painted green?
questions.explanation: There are two green faces. Each face of a 4x4x4 cube has (n-2)^2 middle cubes. 2 * (4-2)^2 = 2 * 4 = 8.

hi.explanation: दो हरे फलक हैं। 4x4x4 घन के प्रत्येक फलक में (n-2)^2 मध्य घन होते हैं। 2 * (4-2)^2 = 8।
